title: Slingshot
tagline: Thread probes through gravity wells to reach the relay.
description:
A gravity-assist physics game. Pull back to aim, let go, and let planets, moons and black holes bend your probe toward the relay. Thirty-two campaign levels add moving moons, asteroid fields, repulsors and wormholes, each with three shards to collect and a par to beat.

Survey mode is endless: five probes, ever-deeper space, and a first-shot bonus that keeps a great run alive.
controls: Drag anywhere and pull back to aim and set power; release to launch. Fine-tune with ⟲ ⟳ − + or the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps). Space/Enter launches; hold during flight to fast-forward.
